description: This file defines an interface for AWS S3 result mutator implementations in PHP. The interface specifies a method for modifying a result object based on a command and response, enabling customization of S3 request results.

classes.name: Aws\S3\Parser\S3ResultMutator
classes.description: An interface for implementing custom result mutators for AWS S3 responses, allowing modification of the result based on command and response data.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Method for mutating an AWS S3 result object, utilizing the command and response details to produce a modified result.
